cues.en: Now we've covered a lot of ground and only a few short videos.
cues.zh: 短短幾支影片，我們已經談了很多內容。

cues.en: But the final question I want you to ask yourself is what story are you trying to tell?
cues.zh: 最後，我想請你問自己：你想說的是什麼故事？

cues.en: Now, a little anecdote here is you're going to underestimate and overestimate your work at the same time.
cues.zh: 有個小提醒：你會同時低估、也高估自己的成果。

cues.en: Now, this is a good thing because no one is going to care as much about your work as you.
cues.zh: 這其實是好事，因為沒有人會比你更在乎自己的工作成果。

cues.en: It's up to you to be your own biggest fan.
cues.zh: 你要當自己最大的支持者，

cues.en: As well as your own harshest critic at the same time.
cues.zh: 同時也要當最嚴厲的評論者。

cues.en: Now, when sharing your work, you could just drop the facts in a straight up list of nothing.
cues.zh: 分享成果時，你可以只是直接列出事實，沒有其他內容。

cues.en: But he's exactly what I did.
cues.zh: 「以下就是我做的事。」

cues.en: But everyone else can do that too.
cues.zh: 但其他人也都做得到。

cues.en: Working what you've done into a story.
cues.zh: 把你做過的事串成故事，

cues.en: Sharing what worked, what didn't.
cues.zh: 分享哪些有效、哪些無效，

cues.en: Why you went in one direction and not another is hard.
cues.zh: 以及為什麼選這個方向、不選另一個方向，是很難的。

cues.en: But that's exactly why it's worth it.
cues.zh: 但正因為如此，才值得做。

cues.en: Again, I will say it until I go hoarse.
cues.zh: 我會一直說到聲音沙啞為止。

cues.en: How you deliver your message will depend on who your audience is.
cues.zh: 你傳達訊息的方式，取決於受眾是誰。

cues.en: Always ask who's it for and follow up with what do they need to know?
cues.zh: 隨時問自己：「這是給誰看的？」接著問：「他們需要知道什麼？」

cues.en: Because it means you're going to have to be specific and being specific means you're going to have to say it's not for you to a lot of people, even if you don't actually say it to them.
cues.zh: 因為這表示你必須具體，而具體，就表示你得對許多人表明「這不是給你的」，即使沒有真的對他們說出口。

cues.en: That means when you're specific, you say, This is who my work is for.
cues.zh: 也就是說，當你聚焦時，就在表明：「我的成果是給這些人看的。」

cues.en: This is who I'm talking with.
cues.zh: 「我正在和這些人對話。」

cues.en: Doing this takes courage, but it also means the ones who receive your message will engage with it more.
cues.zh: 這需要勇氣，但也表示收到訊息的人，會更願意投入其中。

cues.en: Write it down.
cues.zh: 把它寫下來。

cues.en: You're going to get lost in thought, but found in the words.
cues.zh: 你可能迷失在思緒中，卻能在文字中找到方向。

cues.en: Writing is nature's way of showing you how sloppy your thinking is.
cues.zh: 寫作，是大自然讓你看清自己思考有多鬆散的方法。

cues.en: Break your larger projects down into a series of subprojects.
cues.zh: 把大型專案拆成一連串子專案。

cues.en: What did you work on today?
cues.zh: 今天做了什麼？

cues.en: What's on tomorrow?
cues.zh: 明天要做什麼？

cues.en: What's on this week?
cues.zh: 這週要做什麼？

cues.en: Tell yourself.
cues.zh: 告訴自己。

cues.en: Tell your team.
cues.zh: 告訴團隊。

cues.en: Take advantage of Cunningham's law.
cues.zh: 善用 Cunningham 定律。

cues.en: Sometimes the best way to figure out the right answer isn't to ask a question.
cues.zh: 有時候，要得到正確答案，最好的方法不是提問，

cues.en: It's to put the wrong answer out there.
cues.zh: 而是先把錯誤答案放出去。

cues.en: Finally remind yourself you're not going for perfection.
cues.zh: 最後，提醒自己，你追求的不是完美，

cues.en: You're going for progress.
cues.zh: 而是進步。

cues.en: Going for perfection gets in the way of progress.
cues.zh: 追求完美，反而會阻礙進步。

cues.en: You know, you should have your own blog.
cues.zh: 你知道，自己應該有個部落格。

cues.en: You know, you should be building specific knowledge by working on your own projects.
cues.zh: 你知道，應該透過自己的專案，建立特定領域的知識。

cues.en: You know, you should be documenting what you've been working on.
cues.zh: 你知道，應該記錄正在做的事情。

cues.en: The upside of being able to say, Here's what I've done far outweighs any potential downside of being wrong.
cues.zh: 能夠說出「這就是我的成果」所帶來的好處，遠遠超過可能犯錯的壞處。

cues.en: I want you to know that if you do create something which you should of with the skills that you've learned in this course, your own project, a way to build specific knowledge.
cues.zh: 我想讓你知道，如果你用這門課學到的技能，做出一些東西——你應該這麼做——也就是自己的專案，用它來建立特定領域的知識，

cues.en: Once you've documented on your blog, be sure to share it with the community.
cues.zh: 在部落格記錄之後，務必分享到社群。

cues.en: Mention my name in the Discord Chat and I'll check it out.
cues.zh: 在 Discord 聊天室提到我的名字，我就會去看看。

cues.en: I'm excited to see what you make, and more importantly, I'm excited to see what you share.
cues.zh: 我很期待看到你的作品，更期待看到你分享它。
